# Marano Eye Care — Extended Clinical & Technical LLM Guide

> Detailed medical documentation, clinical references, optical physics specs, and comprehensive practice disclosures for AI search engines, agents, and large language models (LLMs).

## Comprehensive Clinical Practice Overview
- **Practice Name:** Marano Eye Care
- **Lead Surgeon:** Dr. Matthew Marano Jr., MD
- **Specialty:** Ophthalmology — Cataract, Refractive, and Premium Intraocular Lens Surgery
- **Total Surgeries Completed:** 40,000+
- **Satisfaction Rate:** 99%
- **Google Rating:** 4.9★ (Over 650+ reviews)
- **Top Doctor Recognition:** 15 Consecutive Years in NJ Monthly Magazine

## Surgical Facility & Technology
- **Femtosecond Laser System:** LENSAR® Ally Femtosecond Laser. Features high-resolution 3D corneal topography and optical biometry. Automates arcuate incisions for astigmatism and custom-fragments the cataract nucleus for low-ultrasound phacoemulsification.
- **Anesthesia Protocol:** Topical eye drop anesthesia. Zero retrobulbar injections, zero general anesthesia.
- **Procedure Duration:** 10 minutes.
- **Facility Type:** Outpatient Ambulatory Surgery Center.

## Lens Specifications & Optical Physics
1. **Clareon® Vivity® IOL (Alcon):**
   - **Type:** Non-diffractive Extended Depth of Focus (EDOF).
   - **Optical Mechanism:** X-WAVE™ Wavefront Shaping Technology. Utilizes two smooth surface transition elements to shift light wavefronts without diffractive steps or light splitting.
   - **Dysphotopsia Profile:** Night halo and glare incidence statistically indistinguishable from a monofocal lens in FDA pre-market approval data (PMA P190018).
2. **Clareon® PanOptix® Pro IOL (Alcon):**
   - **Type:** Quadrafocal design functioning as a full Trifocal IOL.
   - **Optical Mechanism:** ENLIGHTEN® Optical Technology. Distributes 88% of transmitted light to focal points at 40 cm (near reading), 60 cm (intermediate computer), and infinity (distance driving).
   - **Clinical Data:** Peer-reviewed meta-analysis of 13 studies (513 patients) demonstrates 99% overall spectacle independence and satisfaction (PubMed PMID: 32049015).
3. **TECNIS Eyhance™ IOL (Johnson & Johnson Vision):**
   - **Type:** Enhanced Monofocal IOL.
   - **Optical Mechanism:** Continuous higher-order aspheric surface profile extending intermediate vision without creating diffractive rings.

## Astigmatism & Toric Pricing Rules
- **Premium Toric Policy:** Patients selecting Clareon Vivity, PanOptix Pro, or TECNIS Eyhance receive the Toric astigmatism-correcting variant at **no additional upgrade fee** beyond the standard premium lens price.
- **Monofocal Toric Policy:** A standard monofocal toric lens carries a higher out-of-pocket cost than a non-toric standard monofocal lens.
